result.summary: The intersection is characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway lacking marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present, the environment is dominated by vehicle traffic with long, unprotected crossing distances for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this large intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signals are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and overhead traffic signals, but is dominated by a wide multi-lane roadway. A large mature tree at the corner creates a significant visual obstruction between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree trunk and low-hanging foliage at the corner block the line of sight between pedestrians waiting to cross and drivers approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground at the corner of the intersection.

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross three lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extension (Bulb-out)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's field of vision past the tree.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Pruning
interventions.description: Prune lower branches of the corner tree to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: This wide, irregular intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, signals, or refuge islands. The expansive asphalt area and lack of clear crossing paths create a hostile environment with high exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked paths for pedestrians to cross this wide intersection, leaving them unpredictable to drivers.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide, irregular geometry of the intersection forces pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without protection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the turn radius.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the wide crossing to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and provide a safe waiting area.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is extremely hostile, characterized by a complete lack of sidewalks and marked crossing infrastructure. The wide roadway geometry and absence of traffic control devices prioritize high-speed vehicle movement over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Walkways
hazards.description: No sidewalks are provided, forcing any pedestrians to walk on the unpaved grass shoulder or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the road in the foreground.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: The wide intersection has no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, creating high exposure for anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense trees and bushes on the right side of the road may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway in the midground.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the roadway to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian-actuated signals to provide safe crossing opportunities.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the roadway and the number of lanes to slow traffic and shorten pedestrian crossing distances.
